## Installation

You can install the development version of predicater from [GitHub](https://github.com/predicater) with any of the following commands:

``` r
# install.packages(c("pak", "renv", "remotes"))
pak::pak("ricardo-semiao/predicater")
renv::install("ricardo-semiao/predicater")
remotes::install_github("ricardo-semiao/predicater")
```
